differences.subject: lower_left_wine_glass
differences.description: The drink in the lower-left glass changes from red to yellow.

differences.subject: grape_above_board
differences.description: A single grape appears above the cutting board in the right panel.

differences.subject: cutting_board_handle_hole
differences.description: The hole in the cutting-board handle is missing in the right panel.

differences.subject: cheese_knife_handle
differences.description: The cheese knife handle changes from light brown to dark brown.

differences.subject: loose_almond
differences.description: A loose almond to the right of the cutting board is missing in the right panel.

differences.subject: corkscrew
differences.description: The corkscrew coil at the top changes length and shape.
